_about: The block library for the procedural unit tokens (INTEGRATION__tokens.py). Original shapes in the MWO design language, written from reference viewing in words and rough ratios; no game geometry is stored here. Daniel can read and edit the wording; the code draws the shapes. 'status' says whether the block exists in the generator.

rule_chamfer.what: every body box has its corners cut (B3.chamfer, 0.007 of the figure height); weapons and tiny parts are not chamfered

canopy.what: teardrop body, round dome nose sloping down and forward over a flat belly, canopy ridge, squared rear deck, a box bay on each rear wing (wider than the body, rising above it) with a cell grid on its face for missiles; the cockpit is the dome

pod_arm.what: lozenge: leaf-shaped in plan (narrows to the muzzle), chamfered, raised spine on top, stub underneath; weapons sit at its muzzle

bracket_upper_arm.what: upper arm with a hanging bracket frame

knee_disc_cover.what: a short flat cylinder across each knee (bird and humanoid legs)

stacked_slab_shin.what: shin made of stacked chamfered slabs with a split fork at the knee end

banana_thigh.what: bent thigh block with a disc at each end

three_toe_foot.what: foot hub with a chamfered plate, two toes forward, one back

ppc.what: smooth cylinder plus a short fat muzzle collar

uac.what: twin barrels with a ribbed collar block

lbx.what: thick cylinder with an underside rail
